name: Peeparr
description: Peeparr is a self-hosted console that discovers scenes from a catalog (StashDB, FansDB or TPDB), sends requests to Whisparr and checks what's already in your Stash library, with a YouTube-style player and library browser.

notes.text: The admin account is created in the browser on first visit.
Forgot the password? Click 'Forgot password?' on the sign-in page, then run `peeparr-reset-password` in the container.
Using TPDB as the catalog? Whisparr-Eros must use Peeparr's TPDB metadata proxy: run scripts/configure-eros.sh --catalog tpdb --peeparr-url http://<peeparr-ip>:3000 (see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).
Building the app needs about 3 GB RAM; you can lower it after install.
